title: Glass supports.
officialText:
Where one or more sides of any pane of glass are not firmly supported, or are subjected to unusual load
conditions, or as requested by the applicant, detailed construction documents, detailed shop drawings and analysis or test data
assuring safe performance for the specific installation shall be prepared by an architect or engineer.
